stem: Thackeray Freight wants a load balancer target group's replacement created before the existing one is destroyed, so there is no gap with zero healthy targets. Which lifecycle argument fits?

choices.text: `count = 2` (creates two independent instances instead of sequencing one resource's own replacement)

rationale: create_before_destroy is exactly the argument that creates a replacement resource before destroying the one it replaces, avoiding a gap. prevent_destroy instead rejects a destroy plan outright; it blocks removal rather than sequencing a replacement. ignore_changes tells Terraform to stop tracking changes to specific attributes; it has nothing to do with replacement ordering. count only controls how many separate instances of a resource exist -- setting it to 2 creates a second, independent instance rather than sequencing the replacement of the one target group already in use.
